pattern: Auto coordinator did routine work on its own expensive model
experience: Auto ran Opus for every request, even easy edits a cheaper model could make, so routine work spent the strongest model's usage.
rule: Otherwise run the work as a native subagent and set its model to the cheapest one that can do it well. Check every result before you reply.

source.thread: CodeShip maintainer feedback on Auto mode, 2026-11-04

notes: Run with the provider's strongest model as coordinator (claude-opus-5-5 or gpt-6.1-sol); with a cheaper coordinator there is nothing cheaper to hand off to.
prompt: Add a `maxRetries` option (default 3) to `uploadFile` in src/upload.ts so callers can choose how many times it retries, and cover it in src/upload.test.ts.

pattern: Auto coordinator handed off a tiny request
experience: A one-line question costs more to hand off and check than to answer, so the coordinator answers it itself.
rule: Size the request first. Do a tiny one yourself: a question, an explanation, a one-line edit.
